terms.label: Project conforms to the detailed spatial plan
terms.definition: The building registry confirms the project conforms to the applicable detailed spatial plan.

anchors.quote: The building permit is issued if the building design documentation that has been filed conforms to the requirements established in legislation, i.e., above all to the detailed spatial plan or design specifications and to the requirements for construction works and for building work.
anchors.note: Detail-plan conformity is the primary positive condition.

terms.label: Project meets construction and safety requirements
terms.definition: The building registry confirms the project meets statutory construction and safety requirements.

anchors.quote: ... and to the requirements for construction works and for building work.

terms.label: Project was prepared by a competent designer
terms.definition: The professional-registry confirms the project was prepared by a competent designer.

anchors.quote: ... the building design documentation has not been created by a competent person or an expert assessment by a competent person has not been performed in respect of the building design documentation;
anchors.note: Competent-designer requirement, stated as a refusal ground.

terms.label: Required site investigations have been performed
terms.definition: The building register records that the building design documentation takes into account the results of the required site investigations.

anchors.quote: ... the building design documentation does not take into account the results of the site investigations conducted at the site of the construction work to be built or the required site investigations have not been performed;
anchors.note: Site-study requirement, stated as a refusal ground.

terms.label: State fee has been paid
terms.definition: The payment system confirms the building-permit state fee has been paid.

anchors.quote: The building permit is issued if the building design documentation that has been filed conforms to the requirements established in legislation ...
anchors.note: State-fee obligation falls under the 'requirements established in legislation'.

terms.label: Project violates the detailed spatial plan
terms.definition: The building registry records that the project violates the detailed spatial plan or equivalent planning instrument.

anchors.quote: ... the envisaged construction work does not conform to the detailed spatial plan, design specifications, ... the requirements established for construction works or for building work, or other public-law restrictions;
